title: MetaDescriptor
description: Compact metamodel summary for GMEBot. concepts: types, containment (targetRef + cardinality), pointers (0..1, type names only), sets, attributes. relationships: separate block for connection concepts (src/dst), e.g. Transition: State -> State. Server maps relationships to WebGME pointer meta on the named concept.

concepts.description: META types (structure, attributes, containment, ordinary pointers, sets).

relationships.description: Connection/link types: which concept connects which types (maps to src/dst pointers on that concept). Listed separately from concepts[].pointers.

multiline.description: Multiline editor; value is language/subtype (e.g. javascript, java).

values.description: Allowed values when type is enum.

targetRef.description: Contained/set member type with cardinality suffix (* + ? :n :min..max). Examples: Transition*, State:0..1.

targetRefOrList.description: One targetRef or a union of contained/set member types.

typeRef.description: Concept name only (no cardinality). Used for pointers and relationship ends (always 0..1 per pointer).

typeRefOrList.description: One allowed concept type, or several alternatives, for a pointer or relationship end.

name.description: Connection concept (must exist in concepts[], typically extends FCO).

relationshipLine.description: Readable line: "ConceptName: FromType -> ToType" (e.g. "Transition: State -> State"). From/To are concept names; union not supported in line form—use object form.

relationshipDef.description: One connection type. Object form or line form (like attribute shorthand).

extends.description: Base concept name (usually FCO for domain types).

contains.description: Valid child types (containment), each with cardinality suffix.

pointers.description: Non-connection pointers (not src/dst—those go in relationships). Each is 0..1; value is concept name or list of allowed types.

sets.description: Set name → member type(s) with cardinality (targetRef).

attributes.description: Attributes defined on this concept only. Omit attributes inherited from extends (e.g. name from FCO); include a name only when this concept overrides the inherited meta rule.
